title: The lead's outcome is recorded through the work package capability
situation: Example 19 (the lead reports a cut's outcome in the design's concepts, naming no file, function or command) failed in every live batch across three profile wordings (2026-10-10): concept outcomes improved, but every report named the realization's files as evidence and sources, because the lead's knowledge of a cut is file-shaped and nothing gives it concept-level names for what it checked. Holding this by role text is the weakest rung of the enforcement order.
decision: Hold it by a capability. The lead records a cut's outcome through the work package capability: for each example, its concept and its outcome in the design's words, with the cut's efficiency figures; the capability names the evidence in the design's terms itself (the example, its check, the work package that serves it), and the leakage inspection warns on any outcome statement that names the realization. The architect reads the outcome there, not a free-text report. Example 19 moves out of the execution cut into the cut that realizes this and 0059, its meaning unchanged.
consequences: The execution cut is accepted without example 19; its number is retired there. One follow-up cut realizes 0059 and 0060 together: the lead's reach into the journal and the lead's outcome by capability. To be classified as a realization decision once classify lands.
